artifact_review:

The Router likely overestimated the severity here; it looks more like natural depth-of-field blur or minor compression than AI smoothing. I will downgrade this severity.
2. Eye Reflection: The asymmetry in eye reflections is a common photographic artifact (catchlights depend on angle) rather than definitive AI failure, unless accompanied by melting. The Topology Auditor found high mask confidence (1.019), suggesting clean boundaries. The 'structural collapse' claim is weak without visual evidence of melting. I will downgrade this severity significantly or dismiss it as normal variance.
3. New Observation: The background blur is very uniform, which can sometimes indicate AI generation, but the subject separation is sharp (confirmed by Topology Auditor). No major new artifacts found.
